nodes.label: Licenses Icon
nodes.description: SVG icon representing a licenses/credentials concept. Shows a rectangular card/document with a user avatar (circle with head silhouette) on the left side, and three horizontal lines (text rows) on the right side, suggesting a license card or ID document. Rendered in blue (#2563EB at 0.8 opacity). Dimensions 28x20.

nodes.label: Blue Icon Color #2563EB
nodes.description: The fill color used in Licenses_icon.svg: #2563EB with 0.8 opacity — a medium blue, not using a CSS variable token.
